newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain markets quiet and little changed.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain markets quiet and little changed.

text.p: UK physical grain prices were little changed on Tuesday on quiet markets.
"The market is still trying to get going after Christmas, but at this rate in will be Easter before it happens," said a trader.
Traders said lower futures during the afternoon may tempt some sellers out, but so far little has happened.
On the fob market January feed wheat traded at 96 stg a tonne for 2,400 tonnes ex-east coast ports.
No trade was reported for delivered feed barley, but feed wheat in East Anglia was fetching 96 stg for Feb while 98.50 and 98 was paid in the Liverpool area.

Milling wheat 11 percent protein in the middle of the country fetched 114.50 stg for January while in the Southampton, Tewkesbury, Avonmouth and Gloucester range February traded at 114.50 and March at 115.50 stg.
